evidence_frontier: The latest completed w8 confirmation (PNN‑v1‑W8‑Confirmation) trained Alpha5 w8 and w16 for 50 epochs on ECG200 and obtained aggregate Q.ANT correct 424 vs 441, failing the relative gate (candidate_correct < control_correct‑10). Earlier Exp021 also showed w8 (887 correct) lagging w16 (897) after 50 epochs. Thus the w8 boundary remains unconfirmed.
analysis: Observation: In both Exp021 (50‑epoch) and the subsequent w8 confirmation (50‑epoch) the w8 model consistently underperformed the w16 control by 13–14 correct predictions out of 500, failing the relative gate. Hypothesis: Extending training to 100 epochs may allow the w8 model to close the performance gap, potentially meeting the gate.
hypothesis: Training the Alpha5 w8 model for 100 epochs will improve its aggregate Q.ANT correct count sufficiently to satisfy candidate_correct ≥ control_correct − 10 on the ECG200 test set.

proposal.title: 100‑epoch w8 Confirmation on ECG200
proposal.research_question: Does training Alpha5 with local_width = 8 for 100 epochs close the performance gap to the w16 control on ECG200?
proposal.rationale: The w8 boundary has only been tested at 50 epochs; longer training could allow the narrower local representation to converge better. Confirming this is necessary before concluding that the w8 width is insufficient.

procedure: Train Alpha5 w8 and Alpha5 w16 control for 100 epochs on ECG200 train split (100 samples).
Evaluate both models on ECG200 test split (100 samples) using seeds [42,43,44,45,46].
Aggregate correct predictions over 5 × 100 test samples per model and apply the relative gate.

proposal.success_criteria: Candidate model (Alpha5 w8) must achieve aggregate Q.ANT correct ≥ control_correct − 10 on the 500 predictions (5 seeds × 100 test samples). The denominator is 500 predictions per model.
proposal.risks: If the gap persists, the w8 width will be deemed insufficient, requiring larger widths or architectural changes, consuming additional compute budget. Over‑training could also lead to over‑fit on the small ECG200 train set.
